en.studio.title: About Iroha Studios
en.studio.description: We build anime-related AI and AI agents out of personal interest.
en.studio.more: These are hobby projects, with no aim to make a profit. Iroha-TTS is one of them. Here we share what we make, how we build it, and what we learn along the way.
